input.free_text_description: This system is a task management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for auth, image, mail. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a User, I want to interact with controller advice functionality, so that I can accomplish my controller advice-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with task functionality, so that I can accomplish my task-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use mail capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
